applies_to: coreav-isobmff-write remux_mp4 outputs through scripts/remux_check.py, ffprobe and ffmpeg 7.0.2, MediaInfo 26.10

conditions.output nb_frames: = the packets ffmpeg copies from the output stream

entries.basis: docs/design/remux.md, Fragmented sources: one sample table holds every sample

conditions.packet: equal in stream, dts, pts, size, checksum and side data
conditions.output duration: = the next output packet's dts minus this packet's

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.8.8 and 8.6.1.2: each sample's stored duration is copied

conditions.dropped streams: include a source stream with a tmcd sample entry

entries.basis: docs/design/remux.md, Streams: MP4 carries no timecode track; it is dropped and reported
QuickTime defines chan, ISO/IEC 14496-12 defines chnl; docs/design/remux.md, Sample entries

conditions.source: fragmented (top-level moof), the stream's last edit a media edit of duration 0 with media time m > 0
conditions.MediaInfo Duration: source minus output = m in seconds (within 1.5 ms)
conditions.MediaInfo FrameCount: source minus output = that gap times the output's FrameRate, within one frame (two where the output's last sample is a partial frame)
conditions.ffprobe duration_ts: source minus output = m, within one movie tick in media ticks

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.6: in a fragmented file a last edit of duration 0 lasts to the end of the media; docs/design/remux.md, Fragmented sources

conditions.packet: the last of its stream, equal in every field but the duration
conditions.both files: the same stts and media header duration, the media header duration shorter than the stts sum
conditions.durations: one the stored last sample duration, the other the media header duration minus the other samples' durations

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.1.2 and 8.4.2: both are copied as stored, also where they disagree with the samples; docs/design/remux.md, Samples and timing

conditions.source: fragmented (top-level moof), the stream without an edit list, first decode time d0 > 0
conditions.output: an edit list of an empty edit E and a media edit from media time 0
conditions.packet and start_pts: packets: output minus source = E in media ticks - d0 - the first packet's composition offset, the same for dts and pts, every other field equal; start_pts: the output's is E in media ticks, the source's within its first sample (composition offset plus duration)
conditions.duration_ts: the output's equal to its stts sum; the source's larger by d0 plus at most the first sample's composition offset and duration
conditions.MediaInfo Duration: output minus source = E in seconds (within 1.5 ms)
conditions.MediaInfo FrameCount: output minus source = E in seconds times the output's FrameRate, within one frame (two where the output's last sample is a partial frame)

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.6: the empty edit presents the media at the source's decode times; docs/design/remux.md, Fragmented sources

conditions.ffprobe with -probesize 2000M -analyzedu: the same value for both files, and that value is what ffprobe gives the output by default
conditions.framemd5 header: only the #codec_id lines differ, the output's naming the codec of the whole-file probe

entries.basis: docs/design/remux.md, Output layout: where a stream's first packets lie is the layout's, not the stream's; ffprobe documents -probesize and -analyzeduration as the amount of data it analyzes to fill stream parameters

conditions.both files: the same stts entries, with more than one decode duration

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.1.2: the decode durations are copied; r_frame_rate is ffprobe's estimate, not a stored value

conditions.source: fragmented (top-level moof), the stream's edit list with no edit of duration 0
conditions.source MediaInfo Duration: the sum of the sample durations (from the output's stts) in seconds, within 0.5 ms
conditions.output MediaInfo Duration: the sum of the source's edit durations in the source's movie timescale, within 0.5 ms; the output's edits are checked box by box against the source's
conditions.FrameCount: apart by the durations' gap times the output's FrameRate, within one frame (two where the output's last sample is a partial frame)

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.6 and 8.3.2: the edit list is copied and the track duration is the sum of its edits; docs/design/remux.md, Fragmented sources
